notes: This repository contains the raw data of the MIET-SMLM measurements presented the manuscript 'Isotropic Three-Dimensional Dual-Color Super-Resolution Microscopy with Metal-Induced Energy Transfer'. A preprint including a detailed method section can be found on bioRxiv: https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.12.20.473473 The following datasets are included: single color alpha-tubulin AF647 in U2OS single color alpha-tubulin CF680 in U2OS single color alpha-tubulin Cy5B in U2OS dual color alpha-tubulin AF647 and clathrin CF680 in U2OS For each dataset, the raw data (PTU file) and the results file (TNT.mat file) containing the localization data are provided. Both types of files can be opened with the included version version of TrackNTrace. Updated versions of TrackNTrace might be available on github: https://github.com/scstein/TrackNTrace
